reviews.text: We couldn't be happier with the dog training sessions and the results we received from Toby Anderson's SoCal K9 Consulting. Every goal was met. Toby is the ultimate professional and supplemented every session with an emailed review of what we covered. Highly recommended.

I met Toby a while at a nearby park while I was walking our Frenchie who passed away suddenly.  We were so devastated but welcomed another Frenchie who had to be rehomed because his previous owner also passed away suddenly.  Our furbaby, Mano, is a happy-go-lucky guy, but he appeared to have never been trained by his previous family.  He didn't know how to walk on leash or any basic commands like SIT, STAY, COME, etc.

The reason we contacted Toby was Mano's inability to sit calmly in a moving car and extreme pulling.  Mano would get super anxious during car rides.  He was moving in a moving car so much one day that he changed the shifter in my car from D to N, and I started panicking because my car wasn't moving in heavy traffic.  I contacted Toby next day.

You can tell Toby is very experienced in dog training.  We used a dog trainer before, and while he was great, Toby showed a higher level of knowledge into canine minds and behavior, and he is well versed in different types equipment to train your dog.  Truth to be told, there are many tools out there for pet parents, but do you know how to use them properly to train your particular dog?  Probably not.

Our Mano showed improvement immediately after beginning his training with Toby.  What has greatly helped us is Toby's explanation of why Mano was doing certain things.  You can have a dog trainer that trains your dog, but if you're not trained to be a responsible owner, you will not be able to communicate with or correct behavior of your fur baby.  I really appreciate Toby for teaching me and my partner how to use different leashes and tools.  Walking with Mano used to be overwhelming and tiring, but now he walks with us rather than himself trying to walk us.

We highly recommend Toby for your dog training needs.  We referred our friend to Toby for behavior correction related to marking indoors, and he has improved significantly too.  We appreciate all the advice and wisdom Toby has shared with us.

Toby provided basic training for our 2-year-old golden retreiver. I had training for two previous dogs but I learned more from Toby in just three sessions than with any of the other trainers. Our dog loved Toby and that made it easier for him to learn. He is doing great, no more pulling on the leash, and he listens better. I'd highly recommend Toby!

What a great experience for us.  We have 3 dogs, but hired Toby to work with our 4 yr old dog Bentley.  We recently moved to Sherman Oaks and gave up a large backyard for walkability for us and our dogs (we also missed the west side of the valley). The adjustment was easy for us, Rudy, and Lola, but not for Bentley.  His leash skills were terrible!  We knew we needed a trainer to help with his constant pulling and excessive barking.  Enter Toby.  What a great guy/trainer.  In 4 sessions he helped us get Bentley to follow outdoor commands. I must admit here that Bentley was not a good "student" but the walks are now much less stressful for us and Bentley and we will continue to use the commands and techniques that Toby taught us.  In our final session with Toby - we did four sessions - he taught us, and the dogs, commands and techniques to teach sit, stay, drop it, and more.

I can't praise Toby's ability enough to work with dog's.  He trained us also so we can continue to work on our dogs behavior.  He is the real deal.  Don't hesitate to hire Toby.  Bentley, Rudy, and Lola got to learn beside their brother because Toby cared enough to include them.  THANK YOU TOBY FOR A GREAT EXPERIENCE AND SUCCESS!

Advanced Dog training has been Toby‘s military profession. He combines the knowledge of dogs with specific techniques to get the desired results that the clients would like to have. Throughout his techniques are easy to understand and they work effectively. thank you, Toby for your time, much appreciation, Sam, and Karen.

We had a wonderful experience with K9 Consulting after rescuing a young Great Dane with some fear based behaviors. Within a few sessions, Toby had our pup following commands that helped to mitigate the behaviors, like constant barking, even at family members. He also guided us really well to become the steady leaders for the dog, which was really critical with such a large breed dog, considering that we have 5 small kids. He focuses on practical solutions and is willing to adapt them for the dog and for the family. We felt like he offered a number of different options based on the dogs needs, our comfort level and what our ultimate goal was. He is prepared, thorough, and explained things well with incredible resources provided after each lesson. We will be continuing to work with him as our dog grows, and he will be our first call if we ever get a new dog!

Toby was so helpful, pleasant and knowledgeable. We achieved our goal Earlyof dealing with pearls reactivity to other dogs. She was an excellent student and had an excellent teacher. She is much more calm now on our walks when she sees other dogs.

Toby was a pleasure to work with training my mini dachshund to be a lil mini service dog. I worried it would be too complicated to train my own service dog but Toby took care of all the details, had a whole curriculum with helpful recap sheets, and answered every question I had. After finishing his service dog training academy, his methods work! Best of all, koko-bean adores her new friend Toby!

As a single dog parent with a 12 week old puppy, Toby was a lifesaver.  I was so overwhelmed doing this all by myself, and Toby was by far the most valuable resource for me to not only train my puppy but also maintain my own sanity.

From the first session, Toby met us in our home and showed me exactly how to setup my little guy's playpen, crate, and overall living situation.  The one-on-one sessions were so invaluable, and after only a few short lessons my little guy was quickly picking up on new commands and behavior modifications.  Even more invaluable was Toby's check-ins with us between each of our sessions, as well as replying with the most thoughtful, timely responses whenever I had questions or concerns.

I'm sure I'll be working with Toby in the future as my puppy matures and we can work on more advanced lessons, but for now I can say I am so so grateful to have had Toby help guide me during this overwhelming time!!!!

I started to train my dog with Toby a couple of months ago, originally signed up for a small 5 session course and then kept coming back because of how good he is with pets and the results I saw were instant. I have a very large dog and wanted to make sure I have confidence handling a 150 lb Great Dane. A couple of month later we finished getting my dog a full service dog training. Toby is amazing to work with, my dog loved his training sessions and I learned a lot along the way. Highly recommend SoCal K9 Consulting for any dog owner

I have only had small dogs, but we ended up with our neighbor’s Doberman. We had no idea how to train a big dog, especially with the dog being a Doberman, (to be fair, we were quite terrible at training our little dogs as well) and were not sure we could keep him. Luckily, my brother-in-law, who ended up with my neighbor’s Great Dane, found Toby. My brother-in-law wanted to give these dogs the best chance at integrating into our families since we have never had these breeds. I wasn’t sure I was able to train a dog since I failed quite miserably at training my little dogs, but enter Toby. From the very first session, Charlie learned essential commands and after our fourth session, we had the confidence that we would be able to keep him and to continue to work with him. Now, we have a loving, wonderful new member of our family. Toby was always very patient and kind, not only with Charlie, but also with us. He always listened to our concerns and addressed them all. We always received emailed recaps of the sessions in case we forgot anything and can easily reference the emails. His training style never made us uncomfortable and the way it was all laid out made sense. Should we need dog training again, we would not hesitate to work with Toby again.

We really enjoyed working with Toby, who was recommended to us by a rescue to work with our Great Dane Duke. We have been very happy with the results. Toby is organized, nice, communicative, and a very thorough dog handler and trainer. We would highly recommend him.

Toby is very highly experienced and knowledgeable! He was an expert trainer for myself and my young dog that was being service Dog trained. We always felt very safe and secure in all situations, and we got great results with training my pup. I would very highly recommend him and his team!!

Working with Toby has truly been a life-changing experience for both me and my dog, Oso. After Oso was attacked at just 3 months old, he became very anxious and fearful around other dogs. When Toby first met him, Oso was already a 95 lb, 8-month-old Rottweiler—but despite his size, he was incredibly nervous. What stood out right away was how quickly Oso took to Toby. There was an immediate sense of trust and calmness that gave me so much reassurance from the start.

Before working with Toby, Oso would try to avoid any interaction with other dogs, and I was extremely nervous about putting him in those situations. Toby not only helped Oso rebuild his confidence, but he also taught me how to lead him with calmness and confidence. His guidance gave me the tools I needed to better understand Oso and support him through his fears. Step by step, Toby created a safe and structured environment for Oso.

Thanks to Toby, Oso has completely transformed. He now approaches other dogs with a wagging tail and a sense of ease that I never thought possible. Watching that change has been incredibly rewarding.

Oso is now a happy, confident dog, and I truly credit Toby for helping us get there. I can’t recommend him enough, not only will he care for your dog as much as you do but he provides so much support and guidance. I'm so grateful to Toby!

Toby was amazing to work with and made a huge difference with my 8-month-old pug-terrier mix. My dog was very reactive, and Toby helped tremendously with leash training, nipping/biting, and building strong recall skills.

He’s patient, kind, and incredibly knowledgeable, and he makes the process feel manageable. I especially appreciated that he works with you in your dog’s everyday environment, which really helped everything stick.

I highly recommend Toby to anyone looking for an effective and personalized dog trainer!

Expert, experienced dog training.
Easy to work with and generous with his time and attention. Quick to respond and flexible.

I want to share how grateful I am for Toby from SoCal K9 Consulting. Watching the way he and Ollie connected was really special.

Toby has a lot of knowledge and experience, and he helped train Ollie as a service dog with so much care and attention. I always felt that he really understood Ollie and what he needed.

He was also incredibly organized and professional. After every session he would send a clear summary, and from beginning to end everything was explained in a way that made the process feel easy and even fun.

As Ollie’s mama, that meant a lot to me. I truly appreciate everything Toby has done and I would definitely recommend him.

He has an amazing and natural connection with dogs.  We are so lucky and thankful.

Toby is an amazing puppy trainer. Our Phoebe loved when he would come to our home, bring the treats, and get to work. She learned a lot in 5 sessions. My husband and I really appreciated that Toby set up our girls space on the first session, which actually dramatically changed everything in our home for the better. She really loves her own private space. We have an almost 5 month old puppy that is so well behaved and everyone is so impressed that she listens and follows most of the commands that she has learned from Toby. Some need some work but we give her grace as she’s still quite young and I think she’ll get them soon enough. We’re so appreciative of Toby’s flexibility with our schedules, his patience, and being so loving with our Phoebe. She truly is a good girl and we fall more in love with her daily. Thank you Toby!!!
Toby was communicative, punctual, friendly, professional, and knowledgable. My puppy loved him, which is all I needed to know. Thanks to Toby, Pumpkin is now a certified Service Animal!

We had a great experience with Toby. He was very personable and professional. He genuinely cared about our dogs and made sure they had the best experience. He taught us some real, actionable steps that we can use to help our dogs be well-behaved and happy. Would recommend!

We are so glad we hired Toby at SoCal K9 consulting to train our 9 week old Golden Retriever puppy  who has learnt to sit, stay, come, down, place etc etc - she really loved Toby who was so kind with her- we made the perfect choice and look forward to continuing our training in the future. He really cares about the dogs and their environment and we are thrilled!
Greatly ben̈efitted from training. Received tools to manage my dog. Training geared to my specific needs. Very satisfied with results.

I have a 85lb Goldendoodle named Raleigh who is the sweetest boy but when first meeting new dogs he can act aggressive until he gets to know them.  With our Los Angeles house on the market and a cross-country trip to Lakewood Ranch pending in a 1 1/2 months, I reached out to Toby to help get our doodle ready for the trip.  After 5 sessions I felt much more comfortable about our journey.  I am happy to report we arrived in FL a few days ago after a six-day trip and our experience with Raleigh couldn't have been better!  Thanks SoCal K9 Consulting!!

I highly recommend SoCal K9 Consulting.

I shall miss you my friend, Toby!!! I'm going to manufacture an excuse to see you again, for sure.

Thank you, thank you, thank you, for patiently and expertly imparting your vast knowledge of dog training and the positive management of annoying puppy behavior. You have literally made the difference between my husband and I considering rehoming our Nena and ultimately deciding to keep her. Stupidly, we were initially totally unprepared to manage Nena's rambunctious puppy (mis)behavior. But due to your support and guidance, we decided to keep our sweet puppy. Now we cannot imagine life without her. You are simply the best!
Great experience all around. Toby is very knowledgeable and helped me prepare my pup for plane rides and for hitting her marks on training and tasks. Very impressed.

I wish I had a transcript of my middle of the night call to Toby. I was completely desperate. I had talked with a few trainers before him and they all had such a weird vibe in the way they treated my puppy and they all wanted to sell me a board and train program… Toby was the opposite, super supportive, knowledgeable, he was all about giving me ideas and tools, he had a trick for everything. My 12 week old cane corso was on another level of crazy 🤣😂. Toby not only helped my dog, he helped me. He worked with me trying to find a solution to every issue my dog presented, and believe me there were so many! if he helped me he can help anyone. Now I have a well behaved, social, super calm dog that I absolutely adore.

We are SO grateful for Toby! Our dog Matilda came in as a rescue with some pretty tough leash reactivity and a talent for completely ignoring basic commands and somehow, through patience, consistency, and absolute magic, Toby helped her transform.

Matilda not only learned real skills, she persevered through moments that used to overwhelm her, all because she felt supported and understood. We’ve seen such a huge change in her confidence and calmness, and it’s made our daily walks and routines so much happier.

Toby doesn’t just train dogs — he trains humans too, giving us the tools and knowledge to keep our dog thriving long after each session. The difference in our home is truly night and day.

We couldn’t recommend Tobys services more. If you want someone who genuinely cares, truly understands dog behavior, and gets real results, look no further. Thank you for everything you’ve done for our girl! 🐾❤️

God Bless Toby! I rescued Joe, the super handsome/fit Frenchie appx 3 years…poor guy was given up because “ he didn’t get along with the other dogs in his family”. Joe was constantly ready and willing to attack, chase any dog in sight…With Toby’s training and lots of practice, Joe walks around other dogs with skepticism but no more lunging, pulling…Joe is definitely a one dog home but amazingly happy and content…Thanks to Toby !

Toby is the best! He has such good energy and a true charm with dogs. My puppy has come such a long way thanks to Toby, and I highly recommend his services to anyone who is looking to train their doggy!

When we found Toby at SoCal K9 Consulting, our expectations were high. Not only was the information on his website impressive and informative, all the reviews were stellar! We knew Toby was the right trainer for us and our Cherry Cowgirl, but would he live up to the hype? The answer was, of course he did.

Toby is amazing! For each of our five sessions, Toby came to our home to help ensure Cherry’s training was specific to our environment and needs. He brought all the needed training tools and equipment, and he brought an amazing spirit and energy that we vibed with right away.

Using a variety of different techniques and tools, he’s helped us to be better trainers, handlers, owners and champions for our dog. Plus, she doesn’t eat absolutely everything off the ground anymore! Woo-hoo!

Toby at SoCal K9 Consulting - highly recommend!

We're so grateful for Toby!  He taught us so many strategies for our energetic little puppy.  She responded to him and to the strategies so well and, while we don't seem to have the exact magic he has with dogs, we do now have some effective tools for keeping her happy, engaged, and eager to please.

Toby is amazing! A true professional and helped address reactivity in various settings: neighborhood, in the home, the mall, and dog park!  With previous trainers, I was losing hope but Toby is a lifesaver!! Taught so many new methods!! Wish we met him sooner! Thank you, Toby!

Training Valkyrie with Toby has been a wonderful experience & journey full of laughs.
I look forward to using all the skills and resources taught by Toby.
I highly recommend Toby for his  knowledge and well thought out detailed lessons.
I urge you to use K9 Consulting for all your training needs :) Thanks so much for all your help and support with Valkyrie !!!!
My experience with Toby has been wonderful from start to end! I can finally walk my dog with no pulling and he listens!! Highly recommend!!

We had an incredible experience training our Great Dane puppy, Rocco, with Toby at SoCal K9 Consulting. We completed both the puppy training and service dog training programs, and the transformation in Rocco has been amazing. My husband has experience with big dogs, but Rocco is my first, and Toby has done a fantastic job not only training our dog but also training me!

Toby is exceptionally professional, patient, and thorough with every lesson. He takes the time to ensure both you and your dog understand the training, and he's always willing to address any questions or concerns. His knowledge, dedication, and genuine care for the dogs he works with truly set him apart.

We’re so grateful for his guidance and highly recommend SoCal K9 Consulting to anyone looking for top-quality dog training!
Toby was great! Our dog was barking and jumping on people and generally being an a-hole, but now he is a calmer good buy after a few sessions with Toby :)

Toby is an exceptional dog trainer who transformed my pup's behavior in just a few sessions! His expertise, patience, and genuine love for dogs shine through in every interaction. He tailored the training to my dog's unique needs, using positive reinforcement techniques that were both effective and fun. Toby's clear communication and follow-up tips made it easy for me to reinforce the training at home. My dog is now well-mannered, confident, and a joy to be around, all thanks to Toby's incredible skills. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for top-notch dog training!
Toby was kind to Rupert (our dog) and gave us tools to stop him from barking and chasing other dogs.

Toby is excellent and we highly recommend him. He's got significant experience, listens to the owner, and focuses on the specific issues they think most important. We needed help with housebreaking our 3 yo rescue Frenchie.  We were at our wits end.  Toby proposed several changes that helped immediately  getting her and us on track. Also had several recommendations for equipment and things that would help us. We had him come for three sessions.

He's a dog whisperer and she jumped in his lap when he came over.  He cared about her and her progress. A good owner trains a dog, something that's not always easy.  For that Toby is the guy you need.
Excellent work  done with my  dog and me . takes the time  so you know what to work on and how

Toby is wonderful!  My dog took to him right away and Toby made fantastic recommendations.

He was kind and thoughtful and very professional.

I highly recommend Toby!

Shoutout to Toby – Zed’s Puppy Training Guru!

I can’t say enough about Toby! He is helping us train our puppy Zed, and honestly, the difference has been amazing. From the very first session, it was clear Toby just gets dogs—he has this natural, almost effortless connection with them that’s so great to witness.

Zed immediately responded to him, and we saw progress way faster than we expected. Toby’s approach is calm, positive, and super intuitive—he knows how to make training fun for both the dog and the humans. Plus, he gave us super helpful tips we could actually use day-to-day.

If you’re in Laurel Canyon or anywhere nearby and looking for someone to help with your pup, Toby is your guy. We’re so grateful for the foundation he gave Zed—and us!

SoCal K9 Consulting exceeded our expectations! Toby was an excellent and patient trainer for our 220-pound English Mastiff dog, Coco. At first, Coco wasn’t the easiest student, but with Toby’s expert guidance and structured training, we saw an incredible transformation. Over the weeks, Coco became a star student, responding well to commands and showing great improvement. We highly recommend SoCal K9 Consulting for anyone looking for professional and effective dog training!

After bringing home my 5month old Pomsky I knew I had to start training right away.  I’d read puppy training books, so I had some idea on how to train a pup, but I need to put everything into practice. That’s how I came across Toby. Every week he’d give me techniques on how to establish commands with my puppy.  There is an abundance of experience and knowledge that he provides during each training secession.  As a result of those hands-on training sessions, I know I was able to not only potty train my pup but continue working on several other commands.

I usually don't believe any accolades, but when my problematic dog saw Toby, he immediately went obedient. That man is like a dog whisperer, and he loves animals and knows how to talk to them...
The cat was a bit problematic, he didn't obey him at the first instant but our family pug  did.
I'm not sure what it was. I only paid for a couple sessions as I don't have too much money, Toby trained our pug Louie  on short term, he is so much nicer and doesn't poop in the apartment anymore.
I'm sorry for that detail, it's just what happened. He somehow speaks their language...

i'm a stroke survivor who came to toby needing service dog training for my two year old golden retriever. my dog truly loves Toby he's always excited for his training sessions. my dog Thunder has learned all the commands to be a service dog  with excellent training by Toby, he was able to customize a program based on my specific needs having hemiparesis on the left side of my body. I would highly recommend Toby for any specific type of training for your dog
Toby is the best. In just three sessions, he helped completely transform our 4+ year-old dog (and taught us humans how to stay on track!). We highly recommend Toby!

🌟 We are incredibly grateful for the exceptional training Toby provided for our shy and stubborn miniature schnauzer puppy. His thorough approach and punctuality made the process seamless, and we truly appreciated his flexibility in accommodating our schedule. The training recaps Toby shared have been invaluable and will continue to guide us as we nurture our puppy’s development. Thank you once again, Toby, for your dedication and expertise!

Toby is such an amazing dog trainer! He is so knowledgable about dogs, gives great guidance, and provides organized notes after each session.  He worked with me and my boyfriend to train our two dogs to bark less, walk better on a leash together, and reduce aggression towards new guests in our home. His training has made our lives so much easier - I used to have to walk my dogs separately several times a day each, and now I can walk them together and they are much better behaved. We also feel much more comfortable about having guests over, as he helped us reduce our dog's aggressive behavior. We are so grateful for Toby's help, and highly recommend him as a trainer!

Toby is an amazing trainer. His military training background and knowledge is invaluable, and he is so great about taking all that expertise and making it easily understandable. I thought I was signing up for dog taking, but what I learned was so much more. He educated me on my role as a handler, and I feel confident knowing how to navigate this world with my dog. Highly recommend!!!
Toby is great at what he does. The great thing is those neat recaps he sends after each training session that my wife and I can refer to when needed. Highly recommended.

Tobias was extremely responsive and understood what I needed to do with my dog. His methods, knowledge, attitude and professionalism made the experience very different in such a short time we accomplished so much and he went the extra mile …

Our service dog training came to an end with Toby this past Saturday.  Toby did an amazing job right from the start, gave clear instructions, showed us how each command is done, gave us time to practice and send us recaps.  Thank you Toby, we will miss you!

Toby is a fantastic trainer. He’s incredibly patient, both with the dog and the owner. He comes to each session prepared with tools such as collars,
leashes, etc. Highly recommend and would hire him again.
Toby gave us everything we needed to start our obedience journey with our new german shepherd. He brings a lot of experience and knowledge to the table. Would definitely recommend.

We signed up for the 3 session package to help with our rescue dog. He was a stray and then was in the shelter for almost 10 months so there was no behavioral history on him. Our dog has incredibly high prey drive which is a HUGE problem …

So happy to have been referred to Toby by a good friend.  He was extremely thorough when training our puppy and customized his program to our lifestyle.  Toby also helped acclimate our older dog to living with his new puppy brother, and …

I can't say enough great things about our experience with Toby!  How an ex-military guy could be as sweet, thoughtful and caring to not just "dog" also "handler" is beyond me. He taught us so much without making us feel like we were in a lesson and was patient and thorough every step of the way.
